question: Does the original small-data SFT recipe reduce SQL agent completion on fresh instances of the four fixed query families, consistently across three training seeds?
primary_contrast: Mean paired final-answer accuracy of sft_step12 minus base, equal weighting over training seeds and the four fixed test families.
assistant_turn_sampling: Same flattened-then-shuffled recipe as the historical pilot; 96 distinct conditional turns per seed, with full prior context retained.
evaluation_order: Deterministically shuffled tasks; independently shuffle paired arm order per task and training seed. Save schedule before model calls.

selection_policy_secondary.ordinary_validation: Select sft_step12 only if its observed dev macro-accuracy is higher; ties select base.
selection_policy_secondary.conservative_gate: Select sft_step12 only if dev macro-accuracy is higher and no dev family loses more than 10 percentage points; otherwise select base.
selection_policy_secondary.threshold_status: 10 percentage points is a prospective engineering tolerance, not a statistical noninferiority guarantee.
selection_policy_secondary.candidate_budget: The same two candidates and the same 80 development tasks for every selection policy.
selection_policy_secondary.test_access: Lock all policy selections before any test scoring. Report every policy, including failures and always-base.

rl_scope: Excluded from this confirmatory contrast. Any future RL difficulty/variance pilot uses train/dev only and a separately frozen protocol.

primary_inference.report: Per-seed and per-family paired results, mean paired effect, wins/losses and all offered tasks.
primary_inference.interval: Task bootstrap stratified by fixed family and fault; share resampled task IDs across seeds, average seed effects within each resample.
primary_inference.conditioning: Conditional on these fitted seeds and fixed families; report between-seed range separately. Three seeds do not establish population-level seed uncertainty.
primary_inference.test_peeking: No interim test comparisons or test-based stopping.
primary_inference.missingness: Incomplete campaigns are operational results, not a complete primary quality estimate.
primary_inference.secondary: All family, gate, format, SQL replay, token, and latency analyses are secondary/exploratory.

execution_requirements.billing: Reconcile prior invoices and all outstanding charges; verify current prices and reserve remaining project headroom before any paid call.
execution_requirements.shared_service_caveat: Even provider-confirmed GPU names do not make shared-serverless timing a controlled GPU benchmark.

amendments: Any model, family, hyperparameter, sample-size, or analysis change creates a new version before new test evaluation; retain this version and explain the change.
